background: HSBC Bank plc is the non-ring-fenced UK bank of HSBC, housing the group's European corporate and investment banking, markets and private banking, funded by corporate and institutional deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A+, with two of the three on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is mixed against UK majors, with CET1 of 17.1% in the top quarter but leverage of 4.1% in the bottom quarter, and liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 139% and NSFR of 112% both in the bottom quarter. Every ratio has fallen since 30 Jun 2025: CET1 by 2.3 points, leverage by 1.1 points, LCR by 15 points and NSFR by 5 points (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is a second positive outlook from one of the three, alongside older items on the finance chief's planned departure and a large cut in senior bankers.
